selection: original-video equal LPIPS minimum, MSE and temporal <= 1.01 of both fixed and TAU; fixed baseline always available as fallback
A: blend aligned and zero-motion texture by clamp(confidence-weighted estimated displacement / threshold,0,1); zero threshold means fixed
B: 5x5 split of ungated texture residual; constant fine weight
C: same split, fine weight linear 1 to endpoint across 8 horizons
shared: frozen TAU, history last4, alpha .25, original confidence gate once, pixelcap .03, meanabs cap .001,128x128
test_policy: all three selected configs locked before test; no test-driven tuning; existing test has prior historical evaluation exposure
